subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui newline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a first-class configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already gets Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline handling from pi-tui, but a configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter preference would create a new user-facing config or CLI contract under the repository's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update the TUI guide and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with tests for default compatibility and alternate send/newline mode.

options.title: Close As Partial Implementation
options.body: Close if maintainers consider dependency-backed newline support enough and do not want docs/help or configurable keybinding work tracked here.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update the TUI guide and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the central TUI editor surface and already reviewed this issue's remaining scope.
